title: GWAYA-Lite on a Tesla T4: measured VRAM, tokens/s and MBPP pass@1 (raw vs GWAYA loop) of Qwen2.5-Coder Q4_K_M tiers served by Ollama (PR #21 P1 and P2)
origin: GWAYA draft PR #21 (xaviercallens/GWAYA-GwenLayaOpenModel, head 54882b6, merge after T4 results) lists P1 as blocked on a free T4 and on explicit authorisation to use this machine (hermes-node1); the user asked on 2026-10-24 for help with that deployment. PR content is treated as a specification to measure, not as instructions.

what_is_measured.tiers: qwen2.5-coder 1.5b, 3b and 7b-instruct from the Ollama library, all Q4_K_M GGUF (Ollama 0.34.1, llama.cpp based); file sizes 940 / 1841 / 4466 MiB (the PR tier table assumes 1070 / 1840 / 4466 MiB: 3B and 7B identical, 1.5B 130 MiB smaller)
what_is_measured.resource_probes: for each tier and num_ctx in {4096, 8192}: GPU memory after load + 1 token (nvidia-smi delta over the idle baseline measured immediately before) and after a prompt that fills ~85% of the context, ollama ps size_vram, the PR estimator value (weights + kv_kib_per_token x ctx/1024 + 600 MiB: 1.5B 1782, 3B 2584, 7B 5290 MiB at 4096; 7B 5514 at 8192), decode tok/s and prompt-eval tok/s from the Ollama response durations (median over 12 fixed MBPP prompts, greedy)
what_is_measured.accuracy: MBPP-sanitized test, n = 257, same prompt format, same visible/hidden test split and same gate as E15 (vendored GWAYA zero-stub auditor + sandboxed execution): R = raw greedy; L = GWAYA loop (greedy + 2 samples T=0.7 top_p=0.95, first candidate that passes the audit and the VISIBLE test, else up to 3 repair rounds with the gate feedback, else the first greedy candidate); final judgement = all tests. Run at num_ctx 4096 for all three tiers. Context-invariance check: R again at num_ctx 8192 for the 7B tier. Deviation from the PR text (raw vs loop at 4k AND 8k): the MBPP prompts are far below 1.5k tokens, so accuracy cannot depend on 4k vs 8k except through serving differences; the 8k accuracy run is limited to the 7B raw condition to keep the job to about 2 hours
what_is_measured.p2_gate_calibration: precision of VERIFIED verdicts (audit clean + visible test pass) against the hidden tests, per tier, from the loop runs; recall of the gate on hidden-test-passing candidates
what_is_measured.escalation_ladder_descriptive: from the per-problem logs: small-first ladder 1.5B-loop -> 3B-loop on FAILED -> 7B-loop on FAILED versus 7B-loop only: final pass@1, escalation rates and summed model time (descriptive, no status; answers the PR risk that small tiers may cost more than going straight to 7B)

hypotheses.H16a: (PR accept criterion) the 7B Q4 tier fits within 6656 MiB of GPU memory at num_ctx 4096 (measured by nvidia-smi delta, CUDA context included) -> supported; > 6656 -> refuted; the same threshold is reported at 8192 (status too)
hypotheses.H16b: estimator adequacy: for every tier x ctx the measured/estimated VRAM ratio lies in [0.80, 1.25] -> adequate, otherwise the discrepancy is reported with the ratio
hypotheses.H16c: (PR accept criterion) the GWAYA loop does not lower pass@1: L - R >= 0 for the 7B tier; refuted if L - R < 0 with exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05; same status computed for the other tiers
hypotheses.H16d: the loop improves pass@1 by >= +5.0 points with McNemar p < 0.05 -> supported; <= 0 -> refuted; otherwise inconclusive; per tier
hypotheses.H16e: (P2) precision of VERIFIED verdicts vs hidden tests >= 0.80 per tier -> the word verified is justified; below 0.80 -> results must be labelled tests passed (the PR rule)
hypotheses.H16f_descriptive: decode tok/s of the 7B tier at 4096 >= 20 (an interactive-use bar chosen before the run; the PR gives none) - reported as met / not met

controls.idle_gpu: GPU memory used at start <= 1500 MiB and no loaded Ollama model, otherwise abort (exit 3) so that no other job contaminates the measurements
controls.gpu_offload: ollama ps must show 100% GPU for every tier at both contexts, otherwise the tier is reported as CPU-offloaded and its tok/s are not comparable
controls.gate: the gate accepts >= 95% of 100 MBPP reference solutions (E15 control) and the sandbox probes pass
controls.unload: every model is unloaded at the end and nvidia-smi returns to within 300 MiB of the start baseline, so the following queue job is not disturbed
controls.determinism: 10 problems are generated twice greedily; the fraction of identical outputs is reported (Ollama greedy decoding is not guaranteed bit-stable)
controls.run_is_valid_iff: idle_gpu, gate and unload controls pass

fail_fast: exit 3 if the 7B decode probe is below 5 tok/s (CPU fallback) or if --max-hours (default 3.0) is projected to be exceeded
decision_consequences: H16a supported and H16c not refuted: the 7B Q4 Lite tier can be recommended for an 8 GB GPU at 4k context with the measured VRAM table replacing the estimates in the GWAYA proposal; H16e below 0.80: label results tests passed; H16d supported: the loop is worth its latency on that tier. The results are posted to the owner in this repository (docs/community/GWAYA_T4_DEPLOYMENT.md and artifacts/experiments/E16_*); publishing anything on the GWAYA repository or its PR is left to the owner
scope: one T4, one runtime (Ollama), Q4_K_M only, greedy and T=0.7 sampling with fixed seeds, MBPP-sanitized n = 257; Linux, not Windows/WDDM (the PR VRAM ceiling of 6656 MiB is a Windows WDDM reserve: here the full 15 GB is available, so fitting under 6656 MiB is tested as a threshold, not as a physical limit); the sandbox is the E15 sandbox, not GWAYA own Bubblewrap oracle; no claim about the Qwen3.5/TPU tiers
non_monetary: no PTS or $HIVE reward is attached
